observations.body: Herod’s violence, arrest, guards, chains, doors, and intended public appearance frame Peter’s confinement.
observations.label: Control

observations.body: Light, touch, commands, falling chains, opening gate, city street, and angelic departure unfold before Peter recognizes what happened.
observations.label: Release

observations.body: Prayer, Rhoda’s voice, disbelief, signs for silence, explanation, departure, guard inquiry, and punishment follow.
observations.label: House and aftermath

payload.posture: Follow prison, recognition, house response, Peter’s report, and Herod’s inquiry as one complete sequence.
payload.tension: The praying house initially refuses the messenger’s report while Peter remains outside knocking after an extraordinary escape.
payload.title: Released from prison
